auditMetadata.title: Google Shared Drive Architecture & Provisioning Audit

evaluationSummary.RECOMMENDED_STORAGE: GOOGLE_SHARED_DRIVE -> Q-Saudi Root Folder -> Project Root Folders -> Subfolders & Master Sheet

modelA.reliability: High initially, degrades on staff change

states.description: Project created in Firestore but Google workspace has not started provisioning yet.
Folders are being programmatically created and Google Sheets template is being written.
Folders and Spreadsheet exist, fully mapped inside Firestore, with successful schema verification.
Project Root Folder created but spreadsheet or subfolders failed to instantiate/move.
Google API raised unauthorized, quota-limit, or network connection exception.
Temporary API issue occurred, awaiting explicit administrative retry click.

provisioningOrder: 1. Project Document written to Firestore (State: PENDING)
2. Project Root Folder created inside Corporate Root Folder within Shared Drive (supportsAllDrives: true)
3. Three project subfolders created under Project Root Folder ('imported files', 'reports', 'printable documents')
4. Spreadsheet created in Shared Drive (or My Drive then moved with supportsAllDrives: true)
5. Tab schema and sheet localization instantiated dynamically
6. Google Drive settings updated in project Firestore document, state transitioned to READY

departureRemediation.description: Since all files reside in the Shared Drive, when an employee is deactivated, zero project files are lost. Corporate retention remains 100% sound because the Shared Drive owns the assets, not the individual account.

migrationPlan.description: For existing projects on My Drive: 1. Fetch current googleDriveFolderId. 2. Call drive.files.update with supportsAllDrives=true to add parent of Shared Drive Root Folder and remove previous My Drive parent. 3. Update project document with status and parent details.
